name: Stand to Defend
descriptionTemplate:
{Unfallen Heart} Shield and {STR} generation multipliers +10%. Each stack of {Undertow} grants Ogier: Oathbound +10% Crit. DMG.
For every 1% Crit. Rate provided by Ogier: Oathbound and his equipped WoD & Covenant, the Shield and {STR} generation multipliers of {Unfallen Heart} additionally +0.3%, and the Crit. DMG granted by each stack of {Undertow} additionally +0.3%.
